professionalSummary.text: Frontend engineer on the design system team for three years, implementing components against product designers' specifications under the library's contribution standard.
professionalSummary.witness: Frontend engineer on the design system team of a software company for three years, implementing twenty-six components against the product designers' specifications under the library's contribution standard.

experienceHighlights.text: Wrote accessibility and visual regression tests for each component, with test results attached to pull requests and checked by the accessibility specialist.
experienceHighlights.witness: Wrote the accessibility tests and the visual regression tests for each component, with the test results attached to each component's pull request and checked by the accessibility specialist.

experienceHighlights.text: Reviewed product teams' contributions to the library as one of three reviewers, with release approval by the design system lead recorded in the release record.
experienceHighlights.witness: Reviewed the product teams' contributions to the library as one of the team's three reviewers; the release approval for each library version was the design system lead's, recorded in the release record.

experienceHighlights.text: Supported product teams' adoption of new components through office hours and migration guides, recording in the adoption log which migrations were done by the candidate and which were done by product teams.
experienceHighlights.witness: Supported the product teams' adoption of new components through the adoption office hours and the migration guides, recording in the adoption log which migrations I did and which the product teams did themselves.

experienceHighlights.text: Documented each release's limitations and hand-over conditions in the release record.
experienceHighlights.witness: Wrote the limitation note and the hand-over conditions of each library release in the release record.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Three component pull requests with test results and review records, one release record with limitation note, and adoption log for one quarter, with repository references as verification trail.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: three component pull requests with their test results and review records, one release record with its limitation note, and the adoption log for one quarter, with the repository references as a verification trail.

skills.text: Component implementation against design specifications, accessibility and visual regression testing, review of contributions, adoption support, release documentation.
skills.witness: Frontend engineer on the design system team of a software company for three years, implementing twenty-six components against the product designers' specifications under the library's contribution standard. Wrote the accessibility tests and the visual regression tests for each component, with the test results attached to each component's pull request and checked by the accessibility specialist. Reviewed the product teams' contributions to the library as one of the team's three reviewers; the release approval for each library version was the design system lead's, recorded in the release record. Supported the product teams' adoption of new components through the adoption office hours and the migration guides, recording in the adoption log which migrations I did and which the product teams did themselves. Wrote the limitation note and the hand-over conditions of each library release in the release record.
